displayName: Pmitz sandbox server: requests posing as Firebase Hosting

documentation.content: More than 20 logged events in an hour named Firebase Hosting without coming from a machine of Google's own. A few are forged requests. Many at once, with real users affected, means Firebase Hosting uses an address range that Google's published lists do not have yet: see 'Whose address a request is counted under' in hosted-mcp/README.md.
